implementation_semantics.decision_fit: for every structural decision, independently fit all three declared pairs on exactly the prior 960 completed common H1 log closes
implementation_semantics.residual: under each current alpha and beta, use the final 96 fitted residuals for population mean/std and standardize the final prior-bar residual
implementation_semantics.valid_pair: beta 0.5 through 1.5, R-squared at least 0.70, residual std above 1e-6 and finite residual z
implementation_semantics.pair_ranking: largest absolute residual z among valid pairs, then declared pair order; an infeasible selected pair is skipped without falling back to the second pair
implementation_semantics.direction: positive z shorts first and longs second; negative z longs first and shorts second
implementation_semantics.volume: floor one-percent one-ATR target volume independently per leg; raise subminimum legs to 0.01 only when the final two-leg loss is at most four percent and leg-risk ratio at most 2.5
implementation_semantics.quote_book: CSV OHLC is Bid and Ask is Bid plus recorded spread times 0.01
implementation_semantics.intrabar: joint long-low/short-high is adverse, long-high/short-low favorable, -1R stop is checked before +1.5R take and threshold execution is used
implementation_semantics.close: if no PnL threshold fires, close on frozen-entry residual-mean crossing or at the third common H1 close
implementation_semantics.stress: subtract one additional decision spread cost for each leg from the spread-aware actual basket PnL
implementation_semantics.capacity: one basket at a time; capacity returns at the common H1 open after its exit bar
implementation_semantics.normal_trading_day: server date with at least 20 common H1 bars; a pair counts as one start
implementation_semantics.output_atomicity: stage development or confirmation under the family artifact root and replace the final directory only after complete strict-JSON output
